svg.aria-label: Five rows, each a rule about hitting the ball on: foul, foul and a miss, three misses, when no miss is called, and the free ball

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: When you are snookered: what the rules say

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: You must try your best to hit a ball on first.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The white hits a ball not on first, or hits nothing.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Your opponent gets 4 points, or the value of the ball you hit if higher (the blue first: 5).

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The referee judges you did not try your best to hit the ball on.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Your opponent may have the balls put back and make you play the shot again.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If a straight line to a full-ball hit on a ball on was open, a miss is always called.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: After the second miss the referee warns you; a third one loses the frame.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If no way to hit the ball on exists, play at it (directly or off cushions) hard enough

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to reach it. Also no miss if a player needs snookers and the referee judges it was not on purpose.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If your opponent's foul leaves you snookered, you may name any ball as the ball on.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It counts as the ball on for that shot; if potted, a colour is put back on its spot.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: WPBSA Official Rules 2024-25: Section 3 Rules 11 (penalty values), 12 (free ball), 14 (foul and a miss). Wording simplified.
